title: Record the chirp residue step
body:
## Summary
- The chirp residue update preserves `v = c j^2` and `Delta = c(2j+1)` modulo `2r`, because `(j+1)^2 - j^2 = 2j+1` and the second difference is 2.
- All 6,141 one-axis rollouts through `ell = 12` return to zero, the 21,840 two-axis states match the closed form, and all 3,905 visit tuples stay strictly below `2T`.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
